body.message:
Hello, my name is Sanja.

I’m looking for a fully furnished apartment in Dubai for my partner and myself for approximately one month, from 11 October 2026 to 10 November 2026, with the possibility of extending on a month-to-month basis.

Ideally, I’m looking for:

• A 1-bedroom apartment
• Fully furnished and equipped
• Private balcony
• Swimming pool and gym
• Beachfront or within very easy walking distance to the beach
• Close to Dubai Marina Mall, Dubai Marina and JBR
• Restaurants, cafés and supermarkets nearby
• Preferably utilities/Wi-Fi included
• No long-term annual lease, as I require a flexible monthly arrangement

I’m particularly interested in JBR or Dubai Marina, but I’m happy to consider other areas you would recommend that offer a similar beachside lifestyle.

Could you please send me any apartments you have available for 11 October to 10 November, including the total monthly price, all additional fees, deposit, photos and exact location?

If we are happy with the apartment, there is a good possibility that we will extend our stay beyond the first month.

Please note that our maximum total budget is AUD $2,000, so we would only be able to consider options within this amount.

Thank you,
Sanja
